items.title: Root npm test self-bootstraps packages/utils via a pretest so the full suite no longer fails when utils/dist is absent
items.context: Add a root pretest that builds both packages/main and packages/utils before full-suite-runner. Prove with a repro-first RED that a bin/lattice.js-dependent path fails via bootstrap-runner when packages/utils/dist is missing, and that the pretest wiring rebuilds utils so it recovers. dist is gitignored so the rebuild will not dirty the tree.

happy.desc: Run `npm run pretest` from repo root -> exits 0, packages/utils/dist/index.js exists afterward; WHY: proves the pretest actually builds utils

Run the RED test `node packages/main/tests/red/red-fb7b-pretest-builds-utils.mjs` -> prints PASS, exits 0; WHY: the repro-first guard itself validates structural, invariant-link, and behavioral correctness in one shot

Run bare `npm test` (no prior manual build) -> npm lifecycle fires pretest automatically, full-suite bootstrap succeeds (no Missing build artifacts error from bootstrap-runner.js); WHY: proves the end-to-end done_required path self-bootstraps without manual intervention

Run the compiled structural smoke directly via `node packages/main/dist/tasks/test-suite-utils-autobuild-smoke.js` -> exits 0, prints PASS; WHY: the structural smoke (not the heavier behavioral RED) is the permanent regression guard that runs in everyday `lattice validate`

edge.desc: Inspect the pretest script string: packages/main build appears before packages/utils build -> ordering assertion passes; WHY: utils tooling may assume main dist exists, so main-before-utils ordering is load-bearing

Run `npm run pretest` twice consecutively, then `git diff --stat` and `git status --porcelain` -> no dirty tree (no untracked or modified files); WHY: dist is gitignored, so idempotent rebuilds must not produce tree dirt that blocks done_required git-clean checks
After `npm run pretest`, confirm packages/main/dist/index.js ALSO exists (not just utils); WHY: pretest must build both packages, not regress the main build by only adding utils

Grep lattice.config.json validate.commands for an entry whose args include `test-suite-utils-autobuild-smoke` -> entry exists; WHY: the smoke must be registered in validate.commands so it runs as a permanent guard during every `lattice validate`, not just manually

adversarial.desc: Temporarily replace pretest with `echo ok` (no-op) -> RED test must FAIL at the structural or behavioral assertion (pretest does not actually build utils); WHY: guard must catch a pretest that exists syntactically but does not perform the real build

Temporarily replace pretest with a command that builds only packages/main (omits utils) -> RED test must FAIL at the utils-build assertion; WHY: guard must catch partial builds that leave the utils gap open

Temporarily delete the pretest key from root package.json -> RED test must FAIL at the first structural assertion (no pretest script); WHY: removal of the fix must be detected, preventing silent regression

Temporarily remove the `test-suite-utils-autobuild-smoke` entry from lattice.config.json validate.commands, then run `lattice validate` -> the smoke does NOT execute (no PASS line from it); WHY: proves the validate.commands wiring is the sole dispatch mechanism -- if the entry is absent the guard is silently absent from everyday validation

Temporarily delete the pretest key from root package.json, then run `node packages/main/dist/tasks/test-suite-utils-autobuild-smoke.js` -> the structural smoke FAILS (exits non-zero); WHY: the permanent guard must detect pretest removal independently of the RED test, since validate.commands runs the smoke not the RED

verificationEvidence.note: guard-bite confirms the smoke entry is registered in validate.commands
